rule: R-ENF-04 / the population of studies is the book, not the study directories
note: SEEDED 06-09-2026, when this gate's POPULATION was re-pointed from the engine/*_study glob to the delivered studies [R-ENF-04]. All 90 covered names carry a delivered valuation study under files/; these 67 commit no record directory, so no gate in this repository can read their central and the spot they were struck at, and this gate had never once put their published fair values against a price while reporting itself population-anchored. THE LIST IS THE DEBT MADE COUNTABLE, not an excuse: an unreadable answer is not a clean one, and every one of these names publishes a fair value on the live site. Seeding a NEW list is the ratchet's sanctioned move (the same as anchor_age_outstanding at four); GROWING it is not, and it may only ever SHORTEN as each name acquires a committed record. IT IS NOT INTERCHANGEABLE WITH `unreadable`, which excuses a study whose record exists and whose numbers expose no answer -- a name in both, or moving between them, goes RED until the move is recorded, because otherwise a study escapes a real unreadable answer by being re-filed as merely undirectoried [R-TERM-01's negative-control lesson]. MOVED OUT OF gap_outstanding.json THE SAME DAY IT WAS SEEDED: it was about to be copied into ten sibling gates, one list each, all carrying these same names — [L-084] and the prose-figures finding, caught by surveying the ten before editing them. A name having no committed record is a PROPERTY OF THE BOOK, so it is recorded once here and every gate reads it. What stays per-gate is only what is genuinely per-gate: which names have a record that gate cannot read.
